f.title: PBRER should evaluate new interval information against cumulative data and propose actions

f.title: Apply the serious adverse event/reaction definition
f.statement: A serious adverse event or reaction is any untoward medical occurrence that at any dose results in death, is life-threatening, requires inpatient hospitalisation or prolongs existing hospitalisation, results in persistent or significant disability/incapacity, is a congenital anomaly/birth defect, or is a medically important event; medical and scientific judgement should be exercised for other important medical events.
